notes.title: Ira is OUT of EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After two years, we are now officially releasing version 1.0 of [i]Ira[/i] today, October 3, 2023! We thank you all for your support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268549/78dc9b9d12529b1c11226decbf77badb4aadf25f.jpg[/img]

We’ve talked previously about some of the major changes that you could expect to see in the finished game, and now that it’s out, we’d like to list them all here so you know what to expect from [i]Ira[/i] starting today.

[b]New Stage[/b]
[list]
[*] Try out the new stage after Stage 6!
[/list]

[b]Reworked Story[/b]
[list]
[*] The game story has been reworked by Peter Tieryas, author of the Mecha Samurai Empire series of alternate history/science fiction novels (including United States of Japan)!
[/list]

[b]Backtracking From the Boss Room[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can revisit the stage after a boss fight, before moving on to the next stage.
[/list]

[b]Rebalancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage buffs to all weapons
[*] Health/money rewards (from random drops/breaking objects)
[*] Shop pricing adjustments
[*] Boss attack pattern adjustments
[/list]

[b]Localization Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved English localization
[*] New Japanese localization
[/list]

[b]New Weapons/Relics[/b]
[list]
[*] Now there are more than 150+ weapons to find and use!
[*] Try new synergies from the new additions
[/list]

[b]Bless Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] They now offer more interesting effects than simple stat adjustments!
[/list]

[b]Improved Details[/b]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects and background music
[*] Improved Yeon’s animations
[*] Improved stage generation algorithm
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved UI organization
[*] Improved gold/crystal drop animation
[*] Exiting out during mid-run
[/list]

[b]NPC Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Try your luck with the Crow; he may give you something good, or nothing at all
[/list]

We wish everyone would enjoy Ira, the game where “bullet hell meets roguelike.” 

If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please email ira@nicalis.com with the details. Thanks!

notes.title: Ira Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've been very busy updating and improving Ira to get it ready for its official release, and one of the most important things we've had to work on is game balancing. 

Over the past year, we've added a lot of new features and content to the game. Because of this, we've had to revisit and re-evaluate everything we've created so far, in order to make sure that the new stuff works together with the existing stuff, and that the game is still a lot of fun for as many people as possible.

We've had to adjust weapon stats, modify perk effects, increase/decrease enemies' HP and tweak just about everything where numbers are involved! We're not ready to reveal all the updates in detail just yet, but you can definitely expect some balance changes when the finished game is finally unveiled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268549/3acd430d90c6d4dc9b0798cbd740f4fe3ac7c6ce.png[/img]

We'll have some new things to show you within the next couple of weeks, so please stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Version Patch Notes v0.1.1~v0.1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268549/231d2ff7bb6b4ff3d51c7c39b55d60e3071c9243.png[/img]

Hello, this is ABShot.

Thank you so much for the bugs, problems, and feedback you send while playing.
We will check and supplement it hard.
And in the future, we will be able to share the confirmed supplements and modifications whenever there is a version update.
Thank you.

- Bug and game issues that were confirmed as of September 7th.
1) 1) When the Gunggi's health is less than half, the phase change, if the boss is killed in the pattern of flying with the wind, it becomes impossible to move and the physical strength is worn out by hitting the ice wall.
2) The Moonlight Chaser (third round) tool tip says that six will be fired, but four will be fired.
3) The problem of not applying the power set effect of the 'Beggar's endurance'.
4) The 'Golden hammer' and 'Purified Chaos Soul Decoration' are the set effects of 'Fortification expert', but the problem is that even if it is filled with 2/2, there is no effect.
5) From the second phase of Laura, if you catch all the pawns, it will be recognized as a room clear, so you can't see the hit box in the main groin and roll indefinitely.
6) The problem of disappearing due to consumption even if a tough passive is used to prevent a double attack with 10% continuous speed of 'Steel armor'.
7) Problem that window mode operation without borders cannot be performed.
8) The problem that the discarded item remains on the map.
9) The problem of getting stuck in the base pattern during the battle of the seal stone of the apostle.


- Share the revised and supplemented items for each version.

v0.1.1

1. We modified the part where some monster shots are not affected by volume setting.


v0.1.2

1. The intro skip method was added after the start cut scene.
2. We modified the fact that the pause menu was not visible during some tutorial processes.
3. When the minimap dies with the minimap open, the minimap interface has been modified that does not turn off.
4, When using 'Adamantine Shield' and 'Bronze shield', we modified the parts that did not disappear even if they were destroyed.
5. We corrected the part where the 'MurdererBow's charging attack interface was malfunctioning.


v0.1.3

1. After Deva's death, we revised the problem of some Relics that interfered with the production process.
2. We fixed the problem that the number of clear was not counted normally.
3. We added an option to change the charge attack and avoidance key to the keyboard operation option.
4. We revised the fact that the background of the Yeon-death production looked strange.
5. We fixed the problem that some input guides on the Apostle unlock interface did not appear.
6. Even after unlock the apostle, We fixe the problem that was marked as unresolved in the book.
7. If the player is Blessed on a sliding floor, we have corrected the problem of slipping throughout the game.
8. We fixed the problem that the apostle of sealed memory confined the player.
9. We lowered the physical strength and reward of the sealed apostle.


We will continue to share it through individual posts.
I look forward to your kind cooperation. Thank you.

notes.title: Dev plans for the upcoming official launch.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268549/1f897de4ab4cc3784cef10a551c78a2bea4ad881.png[/img]

Hello, this is ABShot.

It's been a week since the game was released as Early Access.
Thanks to your interest, feedback, and support.

We will do our best to check everything you say and humbly proceed with the project with the mind of completing the game together.

We share our plans for the upcoming official launch.

1. A plan to supplement feedback, bugs, and game issues.
2. First update.
3. Official release.

1. A plan to supplement feedback, bugs, and game issues.
We will frequently supplement the feedback, bugs, and game problems received, and in the future, we will update the version and notify you of the above corrections.

- The feedback supplementation plan. (2021.09.07)
1) We will make it possible to customize all operations.
2) I'll make a skip directing function. Currently, we are currently developing the Start Boss Directing Skip function.
3) In terms of reinforcement experience, we will do our best to supplement the official release of the game from time to time.
4) I will supplement the console operation experience.
5) We will further compensate for the inconvenient experiences you have reported in the apostle's milestone system. (Conversation, options, entry, etc.)
6) We will increase the overall charge speed.
7) We will supplement the award of the suspicious altar to help the mission.
8) If you use the inventory open when moving to the room, we will make sure that there will be no situations that have remained dark.
9) We will supplement the mouse cursor so that it can be seen better.
10) We will supplement the situation and judgment of the traps triggered during the game conversation.

In addition, we will check and fix it from time to time.
We will share the feedback, bugs, and game problems we have received so far through a separate post.

2. First update.
- The estimated date of the first update is November 30, 2021.
- The update details plan is as follows.
1) One new apostle will join us.
2) You will be able to start with some help before starting the mission.
This will not only help beginners, but also reduce the frustration of early repetitive play.
3) New bows, artifacts, synergy, and characteristics are added.
4) With the addition of a new special room, the mission will be more interesting.
5) I will complete the configuration of the soundtrack and add DLC.

3. Official release.
- The official release date is 2022.02.28.
- The contents to be added to the official release are as follows. (It does not overlap with the first update.) )
1) You face the real reality of chaos. (New stage, new monster, new boss. )
2) Steam achievements and trading card functions will be added.
3) One more new apostle will join us.
4) New bows, artifacts, synergies, and characteristics are added.
5) With the addition of a new special room, the mission will be more interesting.
6) We will update the soundtrack according to the update.

I hope you continue to have fun, and I will work hard to make the game so that it can happen.
Please take good care of us until the official release!

Thank you.
